sourceText: User asked whether the existing milestone ledger differs from a proposed acceptance_matrix and pre_review_check hard gate, accepted the layered approach, and requested an execution Markdown document to audit before any implementation.
normalizedOutcome: One auditable Markdown execution plan explains the current milestone/ProofStory ownership model, proposes reference-based acceptance topology and two lifecycle checks, defines rollout/tests/process-fact obligations, and clearly states that no runtime behavior is implemented.
acceptanceClaim: An independent auditor can use the single document to decide whether the proposed acceptance-topology architecture is non-duplicative, mechanically enforceable, migration-safe, and ready to authorize for implementation.
